title: Atlas Edit Proposal — 2026-10-12
body:
## Summary

This proposal includes the following edits:

- **Pay Sky Core Bug Bounty Rewards From The Core Council Buffer** - Pays Sky Core bug bounty rewards from the Core Council Buffer instead of through an Executive Vote, keeping the Executive Vote as an option for large rewards.
- **Add Morpho Oracle Contract Requirements And Clarify Oracle Feed Terminology** - Distinguishes oracle feeds from the Morpho oracle contracts that read them, and allows Morpho oracle contracts to implement custom logic if audited.
- **Grant Spark A 3-Week Morpho Vault Timelock Compliance Exception** - Gives Spark three additional weeks to bring its Morpho vaults into compliance with the Morpho Vault Curation Framework's Timelock Requirements.
- **Exclude Idle USDS Held In A Tokenized Treasury Instance From Utilized USDS** - Excludes idle USDS in a Tokenized Treasury Instance from the USDS on which Prime Agents are charged interest.
- **Centralize Diamond PAU Emergency Protocol Into Sky Core** - Moves the Diamond PAU Emergency Protocol into Sky Core so it covers every Diamond PAU Instance, including Grove's, and adds actions for the Basin and Uniswap v3 Facets.
- **Update Lite Peg Stability Module Authorized Parties** - Lists the eight addresses whitelisted on the Lite Peg Stability Module, previously recorded as none.
- **Add Osero Reward Code Range And Distribution Reward Instances** - Reserves Reward Codes 3000–3999 for Osero, adds eight Osero Distribution Reward Instances, and adds Tracking Methodologies for Arbitrum and Optimism.
- **Add Spark Foundation Grant Authorization: November 2026** - Authorizes two grants from Spark's Prime Treasury to cover November 2026 expenses: 865,000 USDS to the Spark Foundation and 45,000 USDS to the Spark Asset Foundation.
- **Add Grove Foundation Grant Authorization: October 2026** - Authorizes an 800,000 USDS grant from Grove's Prime Treasury to the Grove Foundation to cover October 2026 expenses.
- **Add River SPV II Transfer Asset Instance To Pattern Artifact** - Adds a USDC Transfer Asset Instance for River SPV II to Pattern's Liquidity Layer.
- **Add Osero Gauntlet Vault Deposit Rate Limit Default** - Records a default deposit rate limit for Osero's Gauntlet USDC Prime Morpho Vault V2 Instance, up to which a cBEAM may raise the live limit without a Spell.
- **Housekeeping Updates** - Records the Osero Diamond PAU Controller as registered with the Configurator.
author: adamgfraser
